import sys
import re


def main():
    rows = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.split("|")]
        rows.append(cells)

    if not rows:
        return

    # Determine column widths
    columns = zip(*rows)
    widths = [max(len(cell) for cell in col if cell) for col in columns]

    # Mark numeric columns
    numeric_columns = [all(re.match(r"^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$", cell) for cell in col[1:] if cell) or False
                      for col in columns]

    def fmt(row, num_cols):
        cells = []
        for i, cell in enumerate(row):
            width = widths[i]
            if num_cols[i]:
                # Pad numeric columns on the left
                cells.append(cell.rjust(width))
            else:
                # Pad all others on the right
                cells.append(cell.ljust(width))
        return " | ".join(cells)

    # Header row
    header = fmt(rows[0], numeric_columns)
    print(header)

    # Separator line
    sep = "-+-".join("-" * w for w in widths)
    print(sep)

    # Data rows
    for row in rows[1:]:
        print(fmt(row, numeric_columns))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
